title: French Defence
intro: 1.e4 e6 and 2...d5: a solid pawn chain, then counterattacks against White's centre.

lessons.title: The French and the Advance Variation
lessons.summary: Hit the base of the pawn chain.

steps.text: Against 1.e4, the French Defence plays 1...e6 to prepare ...d5, challenging White's centre with pawn support.

steps.hint: Push the king's pawn just one square.
The d-pawn two squares, supported by e6.
steps.ifWrong: Strike at e4 with the d-pawn.

steps.text: In the Advance Variation White pushes past with 3.e5 and grabs space. White's pawns now form a chain: d4 supports e5.
Attack the base of the chain: hit d4 with a pawn.
steps.hint: Your c-pawn can reach a square that attacks d4.
steps.ifWrong: Strike at d4, the base of White's chain.
steps.ifRight: That is the key French idea.

steps.hint: Develop a piece that hits d4.
steps.ifWrong: Bring the queen's knight to c6, adding pressure on d4.
steps.ifRight: d4 is under fire. Next ...Qb6 adds even more.

feedback.d8b6: Excellent too: the queen hits d4 and b2. The usual order brings the knight out first.
